kyc.label: US E911 address required for Wi-Fi Calling
kyc.note: The MVP has not established a universal passport/identity-document requirement, but Tello requires a US emergency E911 address before Wi-Fi Calling can be enabled.

roamingSms.label: SMS abroad after US activation
roamingSms.note: After first activation in the US, Tello supports international roaming in 200+ countries/territories and Wi-Fi Calling & Text abroad. Standard roaming requires PAYG credit; the line must have been used in the US before roaming.

wifiCallingAbroad.label: Wi-Fi Calling & Text can receive OTPs abroad
wifiCallingAbroad.note: Tello explicitly states that Wi-Fi Calling & Text can receive OTP and verification texts while outside the US after setup.

setup.note: Broadband Facts lists no one-time purchase fee.

tax.note: Government taxes vary by location; Cost Recovery can be up to $0.30. Checkout calculates the final amount.

shipping.note: SIM/eSIM-specific fulfillment cost is not included in this base model.

promotion.note: Cost windows do not rely on a temporary discount.

30.note: Base plan only; excludes tax/surcharges and any SIM fulfillment cost.

365.note: Thirteen 30-day renewals are needed to cover at least 365 days; excludes tax/surcharges.

refundClarity.note: Plan changes/early renewals are charged immediately and unused service is not partially refunded.

paymentProtection.note: Card-network protections vary by payment method and are not scored here.

stockEvidence.note: eSIM/SIM availability is not represented as guaranteed stock.

numberControl.note: Recurring carrier line controlled through the customer's Tello account.

independentReview.invitationContext: Company asks customers to review; treat the score as context, not proof of reliability.

fairPriceCheck.label: Official price baseline
fairPriceCheck.note: This route uses the provider’s own published price as the benchmark. A third-party quote above this baseline may be a markup; this does not prove the official route is the cheapest possible alternative.

data.caveat: Strong overseas continuity after activation, but first activation requires a US cellular connection.
data.kyc: US E911 address for Wi-Fi Calling

data.summary: Initial activation or port-in must be completed while physically in the United States and connected to a US cellular tower.
data.outsideHomeNote: If you are outside the United States now, do not buy this as an immediate activation route unless you can first activate it in the US.

data.inactivity_window: This monthly-plan route is payment/service based, not usage based. A plan lasts 30 days. If the monthly plan ends and is not renewed, the number has a 12-day grace period before expiration.
data.clock_start_or_reset: A plan purchase or successful renewal starts a new 30-day billing cycle. The 12-day number grace period starts after the monthly service stops.
qualifying_activity: Manual plan renewal or purchase of a new plan before the number expires.
Port out during the post-service grace period if leaving Tello.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Calls, texts, data use or account login do not replace the required paid-plan renewal for this route.
A failed payment does not count as renewal.
Tello PAYG has a different 3-month credit-expiry rule and is not the retention model used for this monthly-plan route.
data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Renew the current documented $5 / 30-day base plan.
data.safest_documented_action: Keep Autopay enabled with a valid payment method and optionally enable Tello’s 48-hour renewal notice; verify the renewal succeeds before the service end date.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer before the 30-day renewal boundary.

data.grace_or_rescue_window: 12 days after an unrenewed monthly plan ends. Buy a new plan or begin port-out before the grace period ends.
data.termination_and_recycling: Tello states there is no recovery after the phone number expires. The cited help page does not state the later recycling timetable.

reminder.anchor_label: Last successful plan renewal or purchase date
reminder.anchor_help: Use the start date of the current 30-day paid-plan cycle, not the date you opened this tool.
reminder.description: Verify the paid plan renews successfully before the 30-day service boundary. The calendar event is placed 3 days early as a product-side buffer.
